商品描述
Strong Hold Edge Control Size/weight: Large (5.3 oz) and Travel Size (1.6 oz)
Let’s grow super thick edges and lay them down flawlessly! Our Strong Hold – Thick Edges Edge Control is more than just a styler—it’s a treatment. This powerhouse formula not only delivers all-day hold without flaking or turning white, it also moisturizes, softens, and helps thicken your edges over time.
Why You'll Love It: ️ Flake-free & no white residue ️ Long-lasting, no-shift hold ️ Infused with ingredients that promote hair growth ️ Free of parabens and drying alcohols—no breakage here ️
Who is it for: Great for all hair types, especially 4C.
Pro Tip: For best results, apply to clean, product-free hair.
